Card Q&A.a: No. This effect specifies a card name, so you must have a card whose name is either [WereGarurumon] or [X Antibody] in this Digimon’s digivolution cards. Having a card with [X Antibody] in its traits doesn't count.
Card Q&A.q: This card’s effect reads, “if [WereGarurumon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon’s digivolution cards”. Does having a card with [X Antibody] in its traits count?

Effect: [When Digivolving] This Digimon unsuspends. Then, if [WereGarurumon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to the hand.
